=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32343-32377 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When both state-rewrite attempts fail (IF_STATE_REWRITE_OK false), the code logs state_update_failed but still relabels and closes the source issue, so state points at the closed source and the replacement is untracked.
  WHY: The poller loses track of the replacement and the task is stranded. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT and said it is not a regression. The others rated MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32323-32327,32382-32387 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failed or response-lost `gh issue create` leaves the source open and labelled ai:implementation-failed, and the next poll re-runs the create with no lookup for an existing replacement, so it can create a duplicate.
  WHY: gh_retry makes one attempt and an ambiguous create is not deduplicated. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT with confidence 2. The others rated MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also notes stderr is discarded via 2>/dev/null.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32323-32387 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The re-issue create is not idempotent across poll cycles because no pending-reissue state marker or body fingerprint check prevents a second create.
  WHY: Two open replacements for one failed task would each do the work twice.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32267-32270,32382-32387 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The source_unreadable and create_failed deferral paths are unbounded, with no ai:needs-human escalation. bump_impl_noop_count runs only after a confirmed create, so MAX_IMPL_NOOP_REISSUES cannot trip on repeated failures.
  WHY: A persistent failure warns every poll cycle forever. The sibling path escalates through implementation_failed_defer_state / MAX_IMPL_FAILED_DEFER_CYCLES.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32386 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: IMPL_FAILED_STATE_CHANGED is set unconditionally after a confirmed create, even when IF_STATE_REWRITE_OK is false.
  WHY: Downstream code gated on this flag will skip its recovery branch while the replacement is still untracked.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:4576-4580,4630-4632,4720,4741 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: RESOLVER_TERMINAL_EXIT_CLASS="commit" is armed before git add/commit and never reset after git commit, so later failures are reported with exit_class=commit.
  WHY: The diagnostic record misattributes the failure and control flow is unaffected. gemini-3_1-flash-lite framed it as pre-commit failures, while the other reviewers framed it as post-commit failures such as `git remote set-url` at line 4741.
- External check-run copilot-pull-request-reviewer (no changed file; check-run 42461143212) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The check-run failed with custom_instructions_too_large (HTTP 422) before analysing any diff.
  WHY: No changed hunk causes it and no code change applies.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32343-32377 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After both jq rewrites fail, the replacement exists but state still maps the wave entry to the closed source, and the poller does not track the replacement.
  WHY: Not a regression, since the old code failed silently. The new code adds a bounded retry and a warning, but nothing reconciles the orphan later.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:4580,4632,4720,4741 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The exit class stays commit after git commit, including at `git remote set-url origin`.
  WHY: A set -e failure after the commit fires the EXIT trap with exit_class=commit, a log-only misattribution. Fix: set RESOLVER_TERMINAL_EXIT_CLASS="other" after git commit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32382-32387 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The source stays open after a failed or empty create, and the next poll re-runs the create with no lookup for an already-created replacement.
  WHY: gh_retry makes one attempt, so a create that succeeded with a lost response yields a duplicate next cycle. This is a deliberate trade-off, and the window is narrow.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32267-32270,32382-32387 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both deferral paths are unbounded, and MAX_IMPL_NOOP_REISSUES cannot trip on repeated create failures.
  WHY: A persistent failure warns every cycle and never escalates to ai:needs-human. No deterministic trigger is shown.
- External check-run copilot-pull-request-reviewer | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check-run failed with custom_instructions_too_large (HTTP 422) before reading any diff.
  WHY: No hunk in the PR causes it, so no code change applies.

  Expected change site: the RESOLVER_TERMINAL printf in _resolver_terminal_emit_record, or the report row wording.
  Evidence of absence: The record keys have no head-SHA field and RECORD_KEYS pins them. The row still claims the head part is covered.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
